targetChunk: be dependent on (adj) vs depend on (verb)
clozeTemplate: This test is ___ on the seed data.
acceptedAnswers: This test is dependent on the seed data.
This test depends on the seed data.
This test is dependent upon the seed data.
The test is dependent on the seed data.
The test depends on the seed data.
modelSentences: This test is dependent on the seed data.

We should remove this dependency.
commonMistake: This test is depend on the seed data.
checklistTr: is'ten sonra sıfat (dependent) mı kullandın? (is depend değil)
Fiil kullandıysan is'i kaldırıp 'depends' mi yazdın?
Sonrasında on var mı?
noteTr: 'bağımlı/bağlı' sıfatı = dependent (on), fiil = depend on, isim = dependency. 'is depend' Türkçe ek-fiil (-dir) etkisidir.
verifiedNote: verifier (independent, 2026-10-21): Oxford 'dependent on/upon' (fetched); Longman dependent; Cambridge dependent on; SkELL (skell_3_11, 2026-10-21) 'dependent on the' 5531, 'dependent upon the' 1353; domain: Rails Guides (Active Record Migrations) uses 'seed data'; fixes: noteTr shortened to 2 sentences

clozeTemplate: I did a quick ___ of the logs.
situationTr: [daily'de söylüyorsun] "Loglar üzerinde hızlı bir analiz yaptım."
acceptedAnswers: I did a quick analysis of the logs.

modelSentences: I did a quick analysis of the logs.

commonMistake: I did a quick analyse of the logs.
checklistTr: 'a quick ...'tan sonra isim (analysis) mi kullandın? (analyse/analyze fiildir)

noteTr: analiz (isim) = analysis, analiz etmek = analyse (BrE) / analyze (AmE). 'analiz yapmak' = do / carry out an analysis.
verifiedNote: verifier (independent, 2026-10-21): Longman analysis collocations (fetched): 'do/carry out/perform/conduct an analysis', 'analysis of'; Cambridge 'carry out/perform/conduct an analysis'; Oxford analysis; SkELL (skell_3_11, 2026-10-21) 'did an analysis' 29, 'run/ran an analysis' 6/2 (data/tool context); fixes: commonMistake 'I made a quick analyse...' -> 'I did a quick analyse of the logs.' so it contains only the word-form error ('make an analysis' is marginal, not the target)
